headline: Photo Booth Props
tagline: Instant fun for every holiday photo

scenes.title: Watercolor Santa Disguise
tips: Tape each piece to a straw
scenes.say: Tape each piece to a paper straw so guests can mix glasses, nose and beard.

scenes.title: Ornament Bow Ties
scenes.say: Three patterns on one page means matching looks for a whole family photo.

scenes.title: Merry & Bright Bubble
scenes.say: Bold letters read clearly even in wide group shots, so it's perfect for the big family picture.

scenes.title: Giant Candy Cane
tips: Hold it like a walking stick
scenes.say: Glue it onto card stock and hold it like a walking stick for a playful pose.

scenes.title: Antlers + Elf Hat
scenes.say: Hand one look to each person and snap an easy reindeer and elf couple photo.

scenes.title: Write-In Candy Cane Arrow
tips: Point it at the star of the shot
scenes.say: Write a funny message in thick marker, then point it at whoever is on the naughty list.

scenes.title: Snowman Fedora & Scarf
scenes.say: Swap in a fedora and chunky scarf when you want a snowman look with a bit more style.

tips.title: Before you print
tips.say: Print on card stock so props survive the party, and grab black and white pages to color in.

say.title: Free printable Christmas photo booth props for your holiday party.
say.hook: Just print, cut, and tape them to sticks for instant holiday photos.
say.end: Download them all free at printamoo dot com.
